heading.en: Facility maintenance for the building around your operation
heading.tc: 場地保養：照顧營運所在的樓宇與空間

sub.en: 3form provides facility maintenance covering HVAC, electrical systems, office equipment, and production line layout with first-in-first-out (FIFO) in mind. The exact scope of maintenance and adjustments is confirmed after a series of site walkthroughs, followed by a detailed quotation tailored to your needs.
sub.tc: 3form 提供場地保養服務，範圍包括冷氣及通風（HVAC）、電力系統、辦公室設備，以及生產線佈局（須考慮先進先出 FIFO）。實際保養與調整範圍會於一連串實地視察（walkthrough）後釐清，並提供詳細報價以作匹配。

distinctionNote.en: Looking after production machinery itself? See General Maintenance & Repair above. This service covers your premises, office equipment and production line layout.
distinctionNote.tc: 如需保養生產機器本身，請參閱上方「一般維修及保養服務」。本服務針對場地、辦公室設備及生產線佈局。

heading.tc: 告訴我們您的場地情況

sub.en: Share the site type and what needs covering. We will arrange site walkthroughs to confirm the scope, then send a detailed quotation.
